items.title: A Developer's System for Finishing Online Courses While Working Full-Time
items.pt:
Most people don't fail online courses because the material is too hard. They fail because the course is competing with a full-time job, and the course loses by default. The fix isn't more willpower. It's better project management.

If you build software, you already have the mental models. Here's how to apply them to a course.

items.pt:

items.title: Novo TIM Beta terá 50 GB por R$ 60, mas só entra quem ganhar convite
items.pt:
Na última terça-feira (20), a TIM anunciou o BetaCreator, nova versão do TIM Beta que oferece 50 GB de internet por R$ 60 mensais. O plano mantém o preço da modalidade anterior, mas traz mudanças nos benefícios e na forma de contratação. Para entrar, será necessário receber um convite e validar o código pelo aplicativo Meu TIM.
A oferta inclui acesso a Facebook, Instagram, TikTok e X sem desconto da franquia de dados, além de Deezer Premium e benefícios do TIM Mais.

📱 Veja as melhores promoções

items.title: Joints, Camera, Action! Co-Generating 3D Motion and Video for Arbitrary Rigs
items.pt: Video generation models can now depict remarkably realistic motion. Yet it is unclear how to use this motion beyond pixels: to animate a specific 3D asset and replay the animation in its 3D scene. For instance, a video model can show a monkey jumping over a crossbar, but it cannot return that jump as replayable 3D motion placed in the 3D scene. items.title: AEON: Unifying Video and 3D World Models
items.pt: Current world models for explicit world simulation typically follow two distinct pathways: (1) video generative models (e.g., Sora), which simulate realistic appearances but fail to preserve 3D consistency; and (2) 3D generative models (e.g., Marble), which generate geometrically consistent scenes but often yield static, less realistic observations. items.pt: Game engines and coding agents can specify the layout, motion, and camera of a scene, yet turning such coarse structure into realistic video requires a renderer that follows the structure and completes the appearance it leaves open.
